name: 02421 · Lexington, MA
findings: ZIP 02421 (Lexington) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 67 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02421 (Lexington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
